caption: The drawing depicts two distinct objects placed on a plain, light beige background. The first object, located in the upper right portion of the image, is a sleeveless vest with a high collar. The vest is textured and appears to be made of a thick, padded material with a surface pattern of overlapping blue, green, and purple hues, along with dark outlines emphasizing the contours and sections of the vest. The interior of the collar and the inside edges are rendered in a brownish color. Below and to the left of the vest, the second object is a small, padded accessory, likely a muff, matching the vest's texture and color pattern—predominantly blue and green with iridescent undertones of purple and hints of black. Both objects are depicted with fine detailing and shading, giving them a three-dimensional appearance on the flat background.
title: Tippet and Muff
